description: A Roslyn-powered MCP server that provides C# code analysis capabilities to LLMs. Supports stdio and HTTP transports.
releaseNotes:
Features:
* add project file info snapshot handling and enhance project loading diagnostics (47c8ee2)
* add tests for build host selection heuristics and implement .NET Framework fallback logic (293e896)
* enhance build host probing with detailed diagnostics and error handling (9c07562)
Bug Fixes:
* enhance project loader diagnostics and add probing results to failure context (9c4bca1)
* refactor project loading logic to improve .NET Framework fallback handling (2a91877)
* remove Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.CSharp.Workspaces package references (689f79b)
* update Microsoft.Build.Locator package (978ea5b)
* vendor Roslyn main packages for CI restores (a88c512)
